An exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Accountant looking to take the next step in their career, broaden their business advisory exposure and develop their leadership capabilities within a well-established and highly regarded accounting and advisory firm.


This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional compliance work, build strong client relationships and work alongside experienced professionals across a diverse client base. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to advisory engagements and play an active role in developing more junior members of the team.


About the firm
You will be joining a well-established mid-tier accounting and advisory firm with a strong reputation in the Brisbane market.
The firm provides a broad range of accounting, taxation, business advisory and specialist services to a diverse client base, ranging from established SMEs and business owners through to professionals and larger privately owned businesses.
The culture is collaborative and supportive, with a genuine focus on developing its people and providing clear opportunities for career progression. You'll work alongside experienced professionals while having the autonomy to build your own skills, client relationships and leadership capabilities.


About the role
This is an ideal opportunity for an accountant (either an experienced Intermediate or a Senior) who is ready to take on greater responsibility and wants a role that offers more than just compliance.
You will work closely with clients across a range of industries, providing accounting, taxation and broader business advisory support while taking an active role in mentoring and developing junior team members.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships.
  • Managing a diverse portfolio of clients, including business owners and professionals.
  • Preparing and reviewing financial statements and taxation compliance work.
  • Working closely with clients on business advisory matters including restructuring, tax planning and cash flow management.
  • Identifying opportunities to add value beyond traditional compliance.
  • Working collaboratively with internal specialists to deliver a complete advisory offering.
  • Reviewing work and providing guidance to junior and intermediate accountants.
  • Supporting the development of junior team members through regular coaching and feedback.
  • Identifying opportunities for further business development and building referral networks.
What we're looking for
We're interested in speaking with Senior Accountants who are commercially minded, client-focused and keen to continue developing their careers.
Ideally, you will have:
  • 3-5 years' experience within Australian public practice.
  • Experience working within a mid-tier or established boutique accounting firm.
  • CA/CPA qualification or desire to study.
  • Strong exposure to Australian taxation and accounting compliance.
  • Experience across Division 7A, FBT and CGT would be advantageous.
  • Experience managing a varied portfolio of clients.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Previous experience mentoring or supporting junior team members.
  • The confidence to deal directly with clients and provide practical advice.
  • A genuine interest in developing further into business advisory and leadership.
